canonical-a.why: encoder order; output must not change

canonical-crop-c.why: encoder order with a conformance window; output must not change

truncated-tail-a.why: last slice cut in half; patched output must equal unpatched output

remapped-ids-delayed.why: non-zero VPS/SPS ids, each referenced before it arrives

resolution-changes-delayed.why: two native-size changes (one cropped) whose new parameter sets arrive out of order

pps-before-replacement-sps.why: a PPS sent before the SPS that replaces its SPS id is interpreted with the new SPS

sps-before-replacement-vps.why: an SPS sent before the VPS that replaces its VPS id is interpreted with the new VPS

pending-across-access-units.why: pending state created in one access unit is resolved in a later one; with frame threads this crosses decoder thread contexts

pps-survives-incompatible-intermediate-s.why: a pending PPS that fails against an intermediate incompatible SPS stays pending and resolves against the compatible replacement SPS before the first slice

pps-survives-present-incompatible-sps.why: a PPS that fails against the SPS already present resolves against the compatible replacement SPS before the first slice

sps-survives-present-incompatible-vps.why: an SPS that fails against the VPS already present resolves against the compatible replacement VPS, followed by its waiting PPS

invalid-replacement-sps-keeps-state.why: a same-id SPS that fails once its VPS arrives leaves the valid SPS and PPS usable for later pictures

invalid-replacement-pps-keeps-state.why: a same-id PPS that fails once its SPS arrives leaves the valid PPS usable
